title: Pontoon Boat Rental

services.name: 22 -24ft Pontoon Boat Rental:
services.desc: A $200 refundable credit card reservation deposit is required to hold reservation and it's also used as a damage deposit during boat rental. It is usually refunded right after return of the boat. In case of cancellation by a client, we issue a full refund no later than 24 ho prior to the day of rental. We reserve the right to cancel a reservation due to the storm or hurricane warning or any other severe weather conditions or mechanical issues of the boat with a full refund. The rates do not include 7% Florida sales tax. Credit card transaction are subject to 3% card service fee. We offer pontoon boat rentals and captained tours to the following areas: Haulover Sandbar, Fort Lauderdale

blurb: You will really enjoy the comfort of sofa style seating, premium sound music and of course the breathtaking views of Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway! You will love a boat trip to the famous Haulover Sand Bar, visit many waterfront restaurants, or just relax on a romantic sightseeing boat tour of Miami or Fort Lauderdale. We service Miami, Miami Beach, Hallandale Beach, North Miami Beach, Sunny Isles, Bal Harbour,
